minors.name: Industrial Chemistry
minors.description: Minor in Industrial Chemistry. Must be pursued alongside a Major or Minor in Chemistry. Requires 5 specific advanced courses covering polymer chemistry, green chemistry, and industrial applications.

minors.name: Analytical Chemistry
minors.description: Minor in Analytical Chemistry. Must be pursued alongside a Major, Minor, or BSc in Chemistry. Requires 4 core analytical courses and 1 approved elective.

minors.name: Chemical Biology
minors.description: Minor in Chemical Biology. Must be pursued alongside a Major or Minor in Chemistry. Requires 4 core courses (including CHEM 2471, CHEM 3564, CHEM 3870, CHEM 3871) and 1 approved elective.

minors.name: Materials Chemistry
minors.description: Minor in Materials Chemistry. Must be pursued alongside a Major or Minor in Chemistry. NOTE: Not offered in the 2025/2026 academic year. Requires CHEM 3162, CHEM 3163, CHEM 3564, PHYS 2165 (core) and one elective from CHEM 3578 or CHEM 3563.

minors.name: Mathematics
minors.description: Minor in Mathematics requiring 15 advanced credits. Must be pursued alongside a Major.

minors.name: Statistics
minors.description: Minor in Statistics requiring 15 advanced credits. Note: MATH 2275 overlap rules apply for Math Majors.

minors.name: Electronics
minors.description: Minor in Electronics from the Department of Physics. Requires 5 specific advanced courses (PHYS 2401, 2402, 3201, 3202, 3203). Not available to students pursuing the Major in Electronics. Students must register for PHYS 3202 (not PHYS 3163).

minors.name: Environmental Physics
minors.description: Minor in Environmental Physics from the Department of Physics. Requires the year-long Environmental Physics Laboratory (PHYS 3159) plus 4 electives from PHYS 2156, 2157, 3156, 3157, 3158.

minors.name: Materials Science
minors.description: Minor in Materials Science from the Department of Physics. Requires 5 specific advanced courses: PHYS 2165, 2166, 3164, 3165, and the year-long lab PHYS 3166.

minors.name: Medical Physics & Bioengineering
minors.description: Minor in Medical Physics & Bioengineering from the Department of Physics. Requires BMET 2001, BMET 2002, and PHYS 3160, 3167, 3168.

minors.name: Biochemistry
minors.description: Minor in Biochemistry from the Department of Life Sciences. Requires 9 credits core (BIOC 2061, 2069, 2161, 2169) and 6 credits from electives (BIOC 2162, 2262, 3062, 3262, 3364). Biology majors with this minor must NOT read BIOL 2360.

minors.name: Biology
minors.description: Minor in Biology from the Department of Life Sciences. Requires 6 credits core (BIOL 2061, 2262) and 9 credits from BIOL Level II/III electives. Biochemistry majors should NOT select BIOL 2360. Math majors or Stats minors should NOT take BIOL 2163.
